title: fix(cli): os package publish names the objectstack.manifest.json keys it does not send
body:
domain:server#3 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CXc5hequf76uJfzrdK
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgKURKuRGF1ewEVVZKx7U1i4)_

Fixes #27325

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：`os package publish` 读 `objectstack.manifest.json` 时，若文件声明了它不发送的键（`tags`、`publisher`、`isStarter`、`preview`），打印一条警告，说明这些键尚未被托管目录承接，并附云端跟进卡链接；文件里写了 `visibility` 时另打一条，提示改用 `--visibility`。发包照常成功（exit 0）。
- **为什么改**：清单文件的 schema 接受这些键，作者（含 AI）照写，但发包从不发送，目录里什么都看不到，也没有任何提示。按 triage 裁定（路线 B），先结束“静默丢弃”；真正发送这些键要等云端确认接口（跟进卡 #27348）。
- **风险与回滚**：只多打印警告，请求体与退出码都不变；空白模板自带 `isStarter: true`，因此用警告而非拒绝。回滚即还原本 PR。
- **先看**：`packages/cli/src/commands/package/publish.ts` 新增的 `UNCARRIED_MANIFEST_KEYS` 与 `uncarriedManifestWarnings`，以及 `run()` 里读完清单后那一行；`packages/cli/test/package-publish-uncarried-manifest-keys.test.ts` 的键分区测试。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project unit test/package-publish-uncarried-manifest-keys.test.ts`，预期 5 条全过。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

**The silent path ends.** `objectstack.manifest.json` is validated by `TemplateManifestSchema`, which accepts `tags`, `publisher`, `isStarter` and `visibility` (inherited from `CreatePackageRequestSchema`) and the scaffold-side `preview`. `os package publish` sends none of them, so an author's listing tags or starter flag never reached the catalog and nothing said why. Right after publish reads the manifest (the one place it does), it now prints:

- one warning naming each declared catalog key (`tags`, `publisher`, `isStarter`, `preview`): declared, but the hosted catalog does not carry it yet, with a link to #27348, the cloud card that owns the send leg;
- a separate warning for a declared `visibility`, pointing at `--visibility`, which does carry it today.

The publish still succeeds (exit 0): the bundled blank template ships `isStarter: true`, so a refusal would break every freshly scaffolded app.

**Why warn instead of send.** The only receiver of `POST /api/v1/cloud/packages` is the hosted control plane; no handler lives in this repo. `CreatePackageRequestSchema` declares the keys, but it is not provably the route's validator (the wire is snake_case, and publish already sends a `readme` and a top-level `tagline` the schema lacks). The read-side row stores `tags` as a string, not an array. `publisher` is a trust tier that gates listing privileges, so sending an author's self-declared value is a privilege claim only the control plane can judge. Triage ruled route (B) here and filed the send leg, the `publisher` gate and the `tagline` leg as #27348 (comment 6485703694 on the card). A comment on `UNCARRIED_MANIFEST_KEYS` says not to start sending them before that card answers.

**The class is guarded.** A test partitions every `TemplateManifestSchema` key into sent, warned about, or scaffold-only. A key the schema gains later lands in no bucket and turns the test red until publish either sends it or names it.

**Not touched.** Nothing under `packages/spec`. The top-level `tagline` publish sends is unchanged; its leg moved to #27348 per the ruling.

## Tests

New `packages/cli/test/package-publish-uncarried-manifest-keys.test.ts` (5):

- a manifest declaring `tags`, `publisher`, `isStarter` and `preview` publishes (both POSTs made); exactly one warning names all four and links the tracking issue; none of the keys (nor `is_starter`) is on the request;
- a declared `visibility` gets its own warning naming `--visibility`, without the tracking link, and is not on the request;
- a manifest with none of them prints no such warning;
- the schema-key partition (sent / warned / scaffold-only) is exact and disjoint;
- a fixture carrying every warned key parses against `TemplateManifestSchema`, and the helper reports all of them.

<details><summary>Ablation: the warning call removed, at HEAD fdecadf7</summary>

`node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs --file packages/cli/src/commands/package/publish.ts --anchor 'for (const warning of uncarriedManifestWarnings(m)) printWarning(warning);' --delete -- …vitest… test/package-publish-uncarried-manifest-keys.test.ts`

```
ablation-replace: ok mutation landed: anchor 1 -> 0, blob 2464b74d16e4 -> 1c7b57198a9f
× names each declared catalog key it does not send, points at the tracking issue, and still publishes
× names `visibility` separately, with the flag that does carry it
Tests  2 failed | 3 passed (5)
ablation-replace: ok restored: blob == HEAD (2464b74d16e4) and `git diff HEAD` is empty
```

The cli tests import `src/` directly, so no rebuild sits between the mutation and the run.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Deviation, `visibility`.** The card names `tags`, `publisher` and `isStarter`; the ruling adds `preview`. `visibility` is the same defect in the same file (accepted by the manifest schema, silently not read), so it is in the warned set under the bounded in-place exemption, with the seat's agreement. Its warning points at the flag rather than at #27348.
- **`preview`** is a documented scaffold-side key (`TemplateManifestSchema.preview`, screenshots and demo URL). Publish has no screenshot upload path, so it is warned about with the catalog keys, as ruled.
